extension.summary: Radio station artwork and info lookup
extension.description: Looks up artwork and station details for the radio stations in your playlist, using the free Radio Browser database. Shows you what it found and lets you choose what to apply.
extension.news:
0.1.1 - Added screenshots. No change to how the add-on works.
0.1.0 - First release. Find stations by genre or name, listen before adding them, and fill in artwork and details from the free Radio Browser database or the station's own website.
